framework.description: Closed-loop calibration system for example-project calibration swarm. Surfaces honest contradictions via reasoning-engine + run_synthesis + detect_contradictions, automatically adjusts synthesis weights, source_boost, page_type boosts, recency (via temporal_freshness_score), graph signals. Persists state under swarm drive. Jobs run via job supervisor. Feeds improvements back to fused experience layer (synthesis, graph fusion, reasoning). Produces self-documenting calibration genomes.
framework.author: AgentDrive Contributors

steps.description: synthesis + graph + reasoning consult state for scoring/fusion
Emit calibration genome for Drive ingest + KG

reasoning_patterns.calibration_loop: contradiction -> actionable delta -> persist -> re-fuse in next synthesis
